title: One PR orchestrator and precise trigger admission
proposed_changes: Add one canonical PR orchestration workflow selecting FAST, PACKET or FINAL_HEAD from changed files.
Make legacy packet/gate workflows reusable through workflow_call, manual through workflow_dispatch, push-to-main verification, or precisely path-filtered; remove unconditional broad PR admission.
Add per-PR concurrency with cancel-in-progress true to every remaining PR workflow.
Retain one canonical complete-suite check per final head; FAST and PACKET remain focused.
Stop committing mutable CI run IDs to candidate branches; record them through post-test control or receipt records.
Add one completion evaluator with stable GitHub Actions source identity.
Standardise ruleset-required PR assurance on ubuntu-latest and CPython 3.11.
Update the active ruleset only to the exact approved stable required context set after provenance checks pass.
out_of_scope: Changing test assertions or application semantics
Publication, selector, semantic, threshold, model, family, candidate or theory changes
Market, probability, risk, exposure or execution authority
New instrument, market, clock, side, dependency, secret or agent write authority
acceptance_conditions: Every current pull_request workflow is inventoried and assigned one future trigger mode.
One orchestrator deterministically selects FAST, PACKET or FINAL_HEAD.
Exactly one complete repository suite runs per final head.
Superseded-head runs cancel through per-PR concurrency.
Required contexts are emitted by the expected github-actions app identity.
Ruleset health preflight passes before and after the change.
Synthetic path-admission fixtures prove required workflows trigger and unrelated workflows do not.
Rollback restores the prior workflow and ruleset snapshots without history rewrite.
Focused and canonical final-head checks pass with QA PASS.
rollback: Restore exact prior workflow files and ruleset snapshot through new non-destructive commits; preserve all DA2 evidence.
